story.headline: Chapters of Togetherness
story.description: From a chance cup of chai in Mumbai to a sunset proposal on Lake Pichola — small moments that became our story.

milestones.title: The first cup of chai
milestones.description: A chance meeting over steaming masala chai at a literature festival turned into a four-hour conversation.
milestones.quote: I ordered a simple masala chai, but found a lifetime of warmth in her smile.

milestones.title: The summer of us
milestones.description: Beach drives in Goa, monsoon coffee in Bangalore, and one late-night call where we both finally said it out loud.
milestones.quote: Surrounded by mountains and ringing temple bells, we realized home wasn't a place, but each other.

milestones.title: A Pichola sunset proposal
milestones.description: Under a blanket of shimmering lanterns on Lake Pichola, Rohan asked the question Meera's heart had answered long ago.
milestones.quote: The lake reflected a thousand floating diyas, but nothing shone brighter than her tears of joy.

intro.heading: About The Couple
paragraphs: Rohan & Meera met in Mumbai over a shared love of books and chai. Their friendship grew into a lifelong partnership through travels, shared dreams, and family bonds.
Their journey includes quiet sunsets on Lake Pichola, joyful travels across Goa and Rishikesh, and a proposal beneath lanterns overlooking the water.
They invite you to join their celebration as they begin this new chapter together on December 12, 2026.
